evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: The aphorism frames rehearsal as the condition for genuinely possessing a capability, appealing to security (conservation) and mastery (competence) simultaneously.
Cadence language appeals to stability and security through regularity, a conservation value.
Self-assignment of ownership signals mastery and accountability, a competence need.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsAbsent
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the value move here equating possession of a capability with having rehearsed it, so that rehearsal becomes the proof of readiness?
